title: South Bay Field Guide: 100 Wonders
dek: A jet-age field guide to the world of Signal Over the South Bay: 100 plants, creatures, tides, winds and skies across eight habitats, each one tagged REAL or INVENTED.

body:
A companion field guide for PointCast's comic Signal Over the South Bay, drawn as jet-age science plates: 100 nature entries across eight habitats, from the Dockweiler dunes and the kelp forest to the El Segundo Blue butterfly preserve, the Ballona wetlands, the Palos Verdes bluffs, Main Street gardens and the night sky.

Seventy-two entries are real South Bay nature: sea fig and sand verbena, giant kelp and ochre sea stars, pickleweed and king tides, the marine layer and the Santa Ana winds, grunion runs, sea glass and the green flash. The El Segundo Blue gets its own habitat. It is a real endangered butterfly that lives almost its whole life on seacliff buckwheat in the dunes beside the airport.

Twenty-eight entries are invented for the comic's world and tagged that way on every card: solar kelp, beacon moss, contrail clouds, signal sand that hums when the Lantern broadcasts, and marigolds that open at 6:45 on the dot. Invented entries are story, not science.

The guide ends with an ecosystem map showing how the moon, the tides, the marine layer and the winds tie the habitats together, with the comic's invented links drawn as dashed lines so fact and fiction stay apart.

Browse every card, with full text for each entry, at /features/signal-over-the-south-bay/field-guide/. The data is also published as nature.json.
